summary: Indian stocks are set to open firmer, helped by softer oil and another day of heavy foreign buying, though weak Asian trade and today's inflation data could cap the bounce.

detail.leaders: Banks and large caps backed by foreign buying; oil-sensitive sectors as Brent eases
detail.laggards: IT and tech-linked names with Asia lower and Nvidia's results pending; Vedanta on a block-related impairment
detail.tone: A pre-open read on the session ahead, more upbeat than the early-morning note as GIFT Nifty points to a gap-up start after Friday's profit booking.
watch: Whether the gap-up holds once Asian weakness is priced in
